name: Ice Rune Keeper
theme: A northern rune guardian who preserves ancient frost magic, controls battlefields through glacial runes, and protects allies with enduring winter wards.
visualIdentity: Frostbound robes, carved rune staff, glacier-blue runes, fur-lined garments, crystalline ornaments, silver fittings, and restrained icy magical effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, robe silhouette, rune staff design, rune carvings, frost accents, crystalline details, and blue-white-silver palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Frozen Ward
starterAbilities.description: Protect allies through defensive frost runes.

starterAbilities.name: Glacial Bind
starterAbilities.description: Root enemies with magical ice and rune bindings.

starterAbilities.name: Rune of Winter
starterAbilities.description: Channel winter magic to weaken and control foes.
